The '''Living Sword''' is a type of [[Weapons|Weapon]] created from a multitude parasite materials.

== ''Usage'' ==

'''Fighting'''

The Living Sword is a Melee Weapon. Its attack reach is 4 blocks in each direction from the players head, which is the default attack reach.

Each time it is swung without being on attack cooldown, it performs a sweeping attack (though only visually if airborne) and applies the [[Bleeding]] Effect to the directly targeted mob with a 23%<ref>needs verification</ref> chance each hit.

'''Evolving'''

Upon killing an entity, it's hp, including possible buffs from health boost, is added to a counter shown in the item's tooltip. 1 second after this counter reaches 50,000, a non-damaging lightning will strike the player, and the held weapon will be replaced with it's Sentient counterpart at full durability.
